_about: What each terminal must connect to, by FUNCTION, written from the circuit's purpose and independent of pin numbers. check_parts.py joins this with the blind datasheet ledger.

two_terminal._pads: KiCad library convention used by these footprints: Device:D and Device:LED pad 1 = cathode, pad 2 = anode.

polarized_pads._pads: Pad 1 = negative, pad 2 = positive on these AMASS footprints (their silkscreen marks); C7 etc: Device:C_Polarized pad 1 = positive.

SW1.evidence: MSK12C02 drawing, top view and circuit diagram: knob drawn at the pin-3 end with the contact joining 3 and 2; dashed at the pin-1 end (1.6 mm travel)
